## Scope

The audit covered 276 second reads taken this quarter. The review considered the recorded outcomes for those reads and assessed the level of agreement across the audit sample. This scope provides the basis for the overall result reported below. Detailed per-grader information is retained separately in the attached spreadsheet.

## Result

Overall agreement was 68.5 per cent. This is the aggregate result for the reads included in the audit and should be considered alongside the supporting per-grader information. Per-grader results are in the attached spreadsheet and are discussed with each grader privately. This approach supports consistent review of the findings while ensuring that individual results are addressed directly with the relevant grader.
